title: 第99章 京都所有青楼的热门人物！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 见到唐逸自信的样子，很多人都觉得唐逸是疯了。　　就连萧棣，这时候也错愕地看着唐逸，心说你小子是不是有个大病？没看到人家是故意针对你，下的圈套吗？　　你还敢主动往里钻？　　同时，他也明白了唐逸为何要他收敛脾气了。　　这种事要搁在他身上，那别废话，管你男人女人有一个算一个全都一起上吧，老子一个人单挑你们一群！　　当然，他是皇子，他能这么做。　　但唐逸不能，就这家伙的身手，人家随便都能玩死他。　　唐敬盯着唐逸，眼底也是一片森冷，看向唐画道：“画儿，那就别和他客气了，我们唐家，没有这种愚昧无知的蠢货！”　　来之前，他就已经告诉过唐画，如果唐逸敢拦路，那便将他也收拾了。　　既然现在唐逸挑事，那便趁机将他给踢了。　　免得陛下到来，又出现意外。　　至于全场的目光，唐敬直接选择无视了。　　嘲笑又如何？戏谑又怎样？谁家还没有一两个没有出息的孩子？　　只要等下唐画能技压全场，现在这些小小的屈辱，算得了什么？　　唐画听到唐敬的话，面上依旧装得有几分的不忍。　　假装思索了片刻，像是没有找到更好的办法，他只能轻叹一口气，有些无奈道：“好吧，既然如此，小逸，那就别怪为兄了。”　　话落，他微微凝眉，脸色变得认真而慎重。　　他看向众人，道：“今日沈园诗会，乃是太傅亲自为孔小姐举办的择婿宴，今日参加比试的，也都是我大炎的青年俊杰。”　　“也就是说，所有参与比试者，都需要真才实学。”　　说到这里，唐画抬头看向唐逸道：“小逸，你是真才实学吗？”　　闻言，刘温，赵柯等人一众大臣，看向唐逸的目光都极为玩味。　　这段时间炎文帝把唐逸当成小诗仙的替身，他们没少在唐逸的身上下功夫，很了解唐逸的情况。　　这家伙在母亲过世之后，在唐家就是个打杂的下人，甚至说连下人都不如。　　连书都没摸过，他哪里来的真才实学？　　真是不知道，他哪里来的底气，敢这么挑战唐画。　　姜云娜盯着唐逸，脸上充满嘲讽和得意。　　哈哈，废物你狂什么？现在画哥哥出手，你分分钟就得原形毕露，等着被群嘲身败名裂吧！　　颜霜玉正在和身边的女人说话，嘴角却时不时轻微勾起，唐逸就是经过她亲手打压的，每天的情况下人都会汇报给她。　　这几年，唐逸为了一口馊饭，都得拼死拼活干活。　　书，他几辈子都没有摸过了。　　就连唐画擦鼻涕的手稿，他都没机会拿。　　虽然这几日他经常跑唐敬的书房，甚至有时候一待就是一宿，但他该不会以为恶补几天，就能成为才华横溢的大才子吧？　　可笑可笑！　　唯独唐音和杜凌菲相视一眼，都冲着彼此眨了眨眼睛，然后，两人不约而同地竖起一根手指在唇边，示意彼此噤声。　　唐逸没才华？　　他是小诗仙啊！　　而唐逸听到唐画的话，只觉得可笑。　　他目光上下打量着唐画，道：“唐画，你别总是将说自己的话，用在我的身上。”　　“真才实学？呵呵……”　　唐逸抬起手中绣春刀，指着唐画：“我懂的，你穷尽此生也不会懂，我会的，你穷尽此生也不会学会。”　　“在我面前秀优越感？你，还没有这个资格。”　　唐画眸色骤冷，装，你继续装！　　装得越好，等下你只会摔得越惨！　　他当即给刘州打了一个眼色，刘州当即会意。　　呵，终于轮到我上场了，颤抖吧，唐逸！　　“哈哈，唐逸，你装什么装？装得你好像很牛逼一样！”　　刘州走了出来，抬手指着唐逸：“一个花钱买诗的废物，以为凭借几首买的诗词，就能威慑全场？就能求娶孔大小姐？做你的春秋大梦去吧！”　　“诸位，我可以作证，他的诗词就是买的。”　　“连当晚他买诗的人，就是平远伯世子，梁绍。”　　“在青楼成功敲开三大花魁的诗，也都是买的残句。”　　当晚和刘州一起在幻音阁的一众狐朋狗友，听到刘州的话，也都纷纷站出来附和。　　“没错，我也可以证明，那天晚上唐逸的诗，就是买的。”　　“这可是梁绍亲自承认的，是他给唐逸买的诗词，是和小诗仙买的。”　　“妈的，要不是他先准备好了诗词，那天晚上早就被刘少给蹂躏了！”　　“……”　　闻言，一群美女看向唐逸的目光，顿时就更加的鄙夷了。　　果然是真的，敢做不敢为，真不是个男人。　　不对，逛青楼的男人，就不是什么好男人。　　顷刻间，整个鹿鸣湖上也是议论纷纷，也都在声讨和怒斥唐逸。　　唐音胆子本来就小，当场就被吓得脸色煞白……她抬手拉了拉唐逸的手，道：“哥哥，青楼是什么？”　　她虽然不清楚怎么回事，但也听得出来，让哥哥陷入被动的爆发点，就是青楼。　　听到这话，唐逸看向刘州的目光顿时冰冷下来，他揉了揉唐音的脑袋：“青楼……就是茶楼，喝茶的地方。”　　打茶围，也算是喝茶吧！　　然而。　　听到他这话，刘州却瞬间来劲了。　　“哈哈，小妹妹，你哥哥骗你的。”　　刘州看着唐音，笑嘻嘻道：“青楼呢，就是男人玩女人的地方。”　　“你哥哥，如今可是整个京都青楼，最热门的人物哦！”　　“要知道，你哥哥前几日在幻音坊，一个人和三个花魁……”　　“闭嘴！”唐逸冷声打断。　　他看向刘州，声音凛冽：“再敢胡说八道，我必杀你！”　　针对他没关系，什么招他都接了，但针对他妹妹，不行。　　杜凌菲也是俏脸冰冷，混账，在一个小姑娘面前胡说八道什么？　　萧棣此时就站在舞台上，手下意识落在绣春刀上。　　刚刚砍了一个小侯爷，老子不介意再砍一个尚书之子。　　“哎呀，他急了，他急了！”　　然而刘州看到唐逸愤怒，指着他大笑：“哈哈，唐逸，你急了，可是你越急，少爷我就越开心啊！”　　“这，就是你作弊的下场！”　　刘州看向全场，道：“诸位，那天晚上梁绍亲自承认，他给唐逸买了十几首诗，就是为了今日的沈园诗会。”　　“像这种垃圾，没有资格参加沈园诗会，我建议……直接将他丢出沈园。”
content_en: Seeing Tang Yi's confident look, many people thought Tang Yi was crazy.Even Xiao Di looked at Tang Yi in astonishment and asked, "Does your kid have a serious illness?"Didn't you see that they were deliberately targeting you as a trap?You still dare to take the initiative to get in?At the same time, he also understood why Tang Yi asked him to restrain his temper.If you want to leave this kind of thing to him, then don't talk nonsense. It doesn't matter whether you are a man or a woman, we can all come together. I will single out a group of you!Of course, he is a prince, he can do this.But Tang Yi can't. With this guy's skills, anyone can kill him casually.Tang Jing stared at Tang Yi with a cold look in his eyes. He looked at Tang Hua and said, "Hua'er, then don't be polite to him. We in the Tang family don't have such ignorant fools!" Before coming, he had already told Tang Hua that if Tang Yi dared to block the way, he would be dealt with.Since Tang Yi was causing trouble now, he took the opportunity to kick him out.To avoid another accident when His Majesty arrives.As for the attention of the audience, Tang Jing simply chose to ignore it.What about ridicule?So what about banter?Who doesn’t have one or two unpromising children?As long as Tang Hua can dominate the audience later, these small humiliations now, what do they count?When Tang Hua heard Tang Jing's words, he still pretended to be a little unbearable.Pretending to think for a moment, as if he couldn't find a better way, he could only sigh and said helplessly: "Okay, if that's the case, Xiaoyi, then don't blame my brother." After saying this, he frowned slightly, and his expression became serious and cautious.He looked at the crowd and said: "Today's Shenyuan Poetry Reunion is a son-in-law selection banquet held by the Grand Tutor himself for Miss Kong. Those participating in the competition today are all young talents from Dayan." "That is to say, all those participating in the competition areEveryone needs real talent and learning." At this point, Tang Hua looked up at Tang Yi and said, "Xiao Yi, are you really talented and practical?" Upon hearing this, Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and the other ministers looked at Tang Yi with great amusement.During this period, Emperor Yanwen regarded Tang Yi as the substitute of the little Shixian. They worked hard on Tang Yi and knew Tang Yi's situation very well.After his mother passed away, this guy became a handyman in the Tang family, even worse than a servant.He has never even touched a book, how can he get his real talent and knowledge?I really don’t know where he got the confidence to challenge Tang Hua like this.Jiang Yunna stared at Tang Yi, her face full of ridicule and pride.Haha, what are you so crazy about, trash?Now that Brother Hua takes action, you will be exposed in minutes and wait to be ridiculed and ruined!Yan Shuangyu was talking to the woman next to her, but the corners of her mouth were slightly raised from time to time. Tang Yi was suppressed by her personally, and people would report every situation to her.In the past few years, Tang Yi had to work desperately for a bad meal.He had never touched a book in several lifetimes.He didn't even have a chance to get Tang Hua's manuscript for wiping his nose.Although he often visited Tang Jing's study in the past few days, and sometimes even stayed there all night, he didn't think that he could become a talented man by just doing some bad work for a few days, right?Ridiculous!Only Tang Yin and Du Lingfei looked at each other and blinked at each other. Then, they both raised a finger to their lips to signal each other to be silent.Tang Yi has no talent?He is a little poetry fairy!When Tang Yi heard Tang Hua's words, he just felt ridiculous.He looked Tang Hua up and down and said: "Tang Hua, don't always use what you say about yourself on me." "Real talent and learning? Haha..." Tang Yi raised the embroidery spring knife in his hand and pointed at Tang Hua: "I understand, but you will never understand it in your lifetime. I know it, but you will never learn it in your lifetime."You are not qualified to show off your superiority in front of me."Tang Hua's eyes suddenly turned cold, pretend, keep pretending!The better you pretend, the worse you will fall later!He immediately gave Liu Zhou a wink, and Liu Zhou understood immediately.Hehe, it’s finally my turn to play, tremble, Tang Yi!"Haha, Tang Yi, what are you pretending to be? You pretend to be awesome!" Liu Zhou walked out and pointed at Tang Yi: "A waste who spends money to buy poems, thinks he can intimidate the whole audience with a few poems he bought? Can he ask to marry Miss Kong? Go ahead and dream of your spring and autumn dream!" "Everyone, I can do it.I testify that his poems were bought.”“Even the person who bought poems that night was Liang Shao, the prince of Pingyuan Bo.”“The poems that were successfully opened by the three great courtesans in the brothel were all fragments of poems he bought.”When Liu Zhou’s words were heard, all the friends who were in Huanyin Pavilion with him that night also stood up and agreed."Yes, I can also prove that Tang Yi's poems were bought that night." "This is what Liang Shao admitted personally. He bought the poems for Tang Yi with the little Shixian." "Damn, if he hadn't prepared the poems first, he would have been ravaged by Mr. Liu that night!" "..." Hearing this, a group of beauties looked at Tang Yi with even more contempt.It is indeed true. If you dare to do something but dare not do it, you are really not a man.No, men who visit brothels are not good men.In an instant, the entire Luming Lake was buzzing with discussions, condemning and angrily rebuking Tang Yi.Tang Yin was timid to begin with, so she turned pale with fright... She raised her hand and took Tang Yi's hand, saying, "Brother, what is a brothel?" Although she didn't know what was going on, she could tell that the breaking point that made her brother fall into passivity was the brothel.Hearing this, Tang Yi's eyes turned cold when he looked at Liu Zhou. He rubbed Tang Yin's head: "A brothel... is a tea house, a place for drinking tea." Playing tea is also considered drinking tea!However.Hearing his words, Liu Zhou became excited instantly."Haha, little sister, your brother lied to you." Liu Zhou looked at Tang Yin and said with a smile: "A brothel is a place where men play with women." "Your brother is now the most popular person in the entire Kyoto brothel!" "You know, your brother was in Huanyinfang a few days ago, alone and three oirans..." "Shut up!" Tang Yi interrupted coldly.He looked at Liu Zhou and said in a stern voice: "If you dare to talk nonsense again, I will kill you."
title_en: Chapter 99 Popular figures in all brothels in Kyoto!
